description: A coloring page sits on an open book on the bed, with an open 64-count Crayola crayon box just above it. The left hand stays on the page to steady it while the right hand reaches up to the crayon box, grasps a green crayon, brings it back down, and shades the right-side blocks on the page with short back-and-forth strokes, then briefly lifts the crayon and resumes coloring in the same area.
